subject: System Design
title: Compression
description: A short lesson to help you apply Compression.

hook.text: A web page is 2 MB uncompressed. With gzip, it's 200 KB. That's 10x less data over the wire.

buildup.text: Compression reduces the size of data transferred between servers and clients.

discovery.text: Brotli compresses 20% better than gzip for web content and is supported by all modern browsers.

twist.text: Compression uses CPU. For high-throughput services, the CPU cost of compressing every response adds up.

climax.text: Compression trades CPU cycles for bandwidth. On most networks, the bandwidth savings far outweigh the cost.

punchline.text: Shrink the data, speed up the transfer.

quiz.question: What does Brotli do better than gzip?
options: Achieves about 20% better compression for web content
